# Luiz Gonzaga Gomes Neto

> Personal portfolio of Luiz Gonzaga Gomes Neto (Luiz Neto), Senior Software Developer based in Natal, Brazil.

## Profile
Senior Software Developer at Linx, building C#/.NET microservices on Azure that handle millions of requests a day. Focus areas: high-volume distributed systems, AI-assisted engineering and AI agents, and secure software development. Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Artificial Intelligence (UFRN) and an MBA in Information Security.

## Projects
- JarvisBot: AI financial assistant on WhatsApp for doctors (MedInvest), built with NestJS microservices, Gemini, BullMQ, PostgreSQL and Docker.
- MedInvest: lead-capture website and API (Express, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Meta Conversions API).
- Delamain: harness for AI-assisted software development (https://github.com/luiznetojc/delamain).
